description: Call this before sending USDC on Arc or Base. One EIP-712 PaySafeVerdict (domain APEX PaySafe, version 1, chainId 5042) covers the payee (Arc poison index, lookalikes, USDC blacklist, OFAC SDN file; Base is the USDC blacklist only and a missing lookalike index is CAUTION), a duplicate of resource+payee+amount+nonce when all three are present, our catalog price, and whether that endpoint has a prior delivered settlement. Verdicts: PASS, CAUTION, DO_NOT_PAY, COULD_NOT_READ. PASS needs every code clean. A missing nonce is CAUTION, not a stop. PayGuard does not read this type. This is not a permission to pay. 20 free a day at /pay-safe, then $0.01. Up to 10 for $0.03 (pass items). 100 prepaid checks for $0.20 are call units, not a USDC balance: pass credit. Hook: /pay-safe/apex-pay-safe.js (onBeforePaymentCreation). It stops only on DO_NOT_PAY, COULD_NOT_READ and a used-up free day.

amount.description: USDC decimal like 0.01, or atomic units (9000 is $0.009) when resource and nonce are set

credit.description: prepaid pay-safe token. Call units, not a USDC balance.

items.description: JSON array of up to 10 checks. 11 is refused whole.

nonce.description: EIP-3009 nonce, 0x and 64 hex. Omit it and the duplicate half is NOT_CHECKED.

payee.description: 0x address that would be paid. Required unless items is set.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (base64, as in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it here and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

resource.description: https resource URL. Needed for the price and delivery checks.

window.description: Seconds for the duplicate half. Default 600.

name: pay_safe
